ko.title: 10년 만기 국채 수익률 해설: 주택 담보 대출, 자동차 대출, 그리고 401(k)에 중요한 이유

segments.src: Most people never check the 10-year Treasury yield.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 10년 만기 국채 수익률을 확인하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Yet it influences the interest rate on a home loan, the cost of financing a car and the value of the stocks inside a retirement account.
segments.tr: 하지만 이는 주택 담보 대출 금리, 자동차 할부 금융 비용, 그리고 은퇴 계좌 내 주식 가치에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: With heavy government borrowing, lingering inflation worries and changing expectations about the Federal Reserve, this number keeps showing up in financial headlines.
segments.tr: 정부의 막대한 차입, 지속되는 인플레이션 우려, 그리고 연방준비제도(Fed)에 대한 기대 변화로 인해 이 수치는 금융 뉴스 헤드라인에 계속 등장하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains what it is, why it matters and what to watch as December approaches.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 이것이 무엇인지, 왜 중요한지, 그리고 12월이 다가옴에 따라 무엇을 지켜봐야 하는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general education only.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 교육 목적으로만 제공됩니다.

segments.src: It is not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: 개인적인 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Rates and market conditions change, so check current figures and consider talking with a qualified professional before making decisions.*
segments.tr: 금리와 시장 상황은 변하므로, 결정을 내리기 전에 현재 수치를 확인하고 자격을 갖춘 전문가와 상담하는 것을 고려하십시오.*

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Actually Is
segments.tr: ## 10년 만기 국채 수익률이란 무엇인가

segments.src: When the U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: government needs to borrow money, it sells Treasury securities.
segments.tr: 정부가 돈을 빌려야 할 때, 국채를 발행합니다.

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is a loan to the government that pays interest for ten years and then returns the original amount.
segments.tr: 10년 만기 국채는 정부에 10년 동안 이자를 지급하고 만기에 원금을 돌려받는 대출입니다.

segments.src: The **yield** is the annual return an investor earns if they buy the note at today's market price and hold it to maturity.
segments.tr: **수익률(yield)**은 투자자가 오늘 시장 가격으로 채권을 매수하여 만기까지 보유할 경우 얻게 되는 연간 수익입니다.

segments.src: Two things are worth remembering:
segments.tr: 두 가지를 기억할 가치가 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Prices and yields move in opposite directions.** If investors want more Treasuries, prices rise and yields fall. If they sell, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: - **가격과 수익률은 반대 방향으로 움직입니다.** 투자자들이 국채를 더 원하면 가격은 오르고 수익률은 떨어집니다. 그들이 매도하면 가격은 떨어지고 수익률은 오릅니다.

segments.src: - **The yield is set by the market, not by the Fed.** The Federal Reserve controls a short-term policy rate. The 10-year yield reflects what millions of investors collectively expect for growth, inflation and policy over the next decade.
segments.tr: - **수익률은 연준이 아니라 시장에 의해 결정됩니다.** 연방준비제도는 단기 정책 금리를 통제합니다. 10년 만기 국채 수익률은 수백만 명의 투자자들이 향후 10년간의 성장, 인플레이션, 정책에 대해 집단적으로 예상하는 바를 반영합니다.

segments.src: Because U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: Treasuries are considered among the safest investments in the world, their yield serves as a baseline, often called the "risk-free rate."
segments.tr: 국채는 세계에서 가장 안전한 투자처 중 하나로 간주되기 때문에, 그 수익률은 종종 "무위험 금리"라고 불리는 기준점 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: Almost every other interest rate is priced as that baseline plus extra for risk.
segments.tr: 거의 모든 다른 금리는 이 기준점에 위험에 대한 추가 비용을 더해 가격이 책정됩니다.

segments.src: ## Why Government Borrowing Pushes on Yields
segments.tr: ## 정부 차입이 수익률을 밀어 올리는 이유

segments.src: The federal government has been running large annual deficits, which means it must keep issuing new debt.
segments.tr: 연방 정부는 매년 막대한 적자를 기록하고 있으며, 이는 계속해서 새로운 부채를 발행해야 함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: A bigger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract enough buyers, especially if demand from big holders doesn't keep pace.
segments.tr: 국채 공급이 늘어나면, 특히 대규모 보유자들의 수요가 이를 따라가지 못할 경우 충분한 구매자를 유치하기 위해 더 높은 수익률이 필요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Investors also pay attention to the **term premium**, the extra compensation they ask for locking money up for ten years instead of rolling over short-term securities.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 또한 **기간 프리미엄(term premium)**에 주목하는데, 이는 단기 증권을 계속 굴리는 대신 10년 동안 자금을 묶어두는 대가로 요구하는 추가 보상입니다.

segments.src: When uncertainty about deficits, inflation or policy rises, the term premium can rise too, lifting long-term yields even if the Fed isn't changing its own rate.
segments.tr: 적자, 인플레이션, 또는 정책에 대한 불확실성이 커지면 기간 프리미엄도 상승할 수 있으며, 이는 연준이 자체 금리를 변경하지 않더라도 장기 수익률을 끌어올릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Inflation Connection
segments.tr: ## 인플레이션과의 연관성

segments.src: Inflation erodes the purchasing power of fixed interest payments.
segments.tr: 인플레이션은 고정 이자 지급의 구매력을 약화시킵니다.

segments.src: If investors expect prices to rise faster, they demand a higher yield to make up for it.
segments.tr: 투자자들이 물가가 더 빨리 오를 것으로 예상하면, 이를 보상하기 위해 더 높은 수익률을 요구합니다.

segments.src: That is why inflation reports, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, can move the 10-year yield sharply on the day they are released.
segments.tr: 이것이 소비자물가지수(CPI) 및 개인소비지출(PCE) 물가지수와 같은 인플레이션 보고서가 발표되는 날 10년 만기 국채 수익률을 급격하게 움직일 수 있는 이유입니다.

segments.src: A useful way to think about it is the **real yield**: the nominal yield minus expected inflation.
segments.tr: 이를 생각하는 유용한 방법은 **실질 수익률(real yield)**입니다: 명목 수익률에서 기대 인플레이션을 뺀 값입니다.

segments.src: Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) give a market-based view of this.
segments.tr: 물가연동국채(TIPS)는 이에 대한 시장 기반의 관점을 제공합니다.

segments.src: A rising real yield means borrowing is becoming more expensive in inflation-adjusted terms, which tends to weigh on the economy and on stock valuations.
segments.tr: 실질 수익률이 상승한다는 것은 인플레이션을 감안했을 때 차입 비용이 더 비싸지고 있다는 의미이며, 이는 경제와 주식 가치 평가에 부담을 주는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Fits In
segments.tr: ## 연준의 역할

segments.src: The Fed sets short-term rates, but the 10-year yield tries to anticipate where those rates are headed.
segments.tr: 연준은 단기 금리를 설정하지만, 10년 만기 국채 수익률은 그 금리가 어디로 향할지 예측하려고 합니다.

segments.src: If markets expect rate cuts, long-term yields often drift lower.
segments.tr: 시장이 금리 인하를 예상하면 장기 수익률은 종종 낮아집니다.

segments.src: If the Fed signals it may hold rates higher for longer, or if inflation data surprises to the upside, yields can climb.
segments.tr: 연준이 금리를 더 오래 높게 유지할 수 있다고 신호를 보내거나 인플레이션 데이터가 예상보다 높게 나오면 수익률은 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Sometimes the two move in different directions.
segments.tr: 때로는 두 지표가 서로 다른 방향으로 움직이기도 합니다.

segments.src: A Fed rate cut does not automatically lower mortgage rates.
segments.tr: 연준의 금리 인하가 자동으로 주택 담보 대출 금리를 낮추지는 않습니다.

segments.src: If investors worry about inflation or deficits at the same time, long-term yields can stay elevated or even rise.
segments.tr: 투자자들이 동시에 인플레이션이나 적자를 우려하면 장기 수익률은 높은 수준을 유지하거나 심지어 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## 당신의 지갑에 미치는 영향

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### 주택 담보 대출

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not follow the Fed directly.
segments.tr: 30년 고정 주택 담보 대출 금리는 연준을 직접적으로 따르지 않습니다.

segments.src: It tracks the 10-year Treasury yield closely, usually sitting meaningfully above it.
segments.tr: 이는 10년 만기 국채 수익률을 밀접하게 추종하며, 보통 그보다 상당히 높은 수준에 머뭅니다.

segments.src: The gap, called the **spread**, reflects lender costs, prepayment risk and market volatility.
segments.tr: **스프레드(spread)**라고 불리는 이 격차는 대출 기관의 비용, 조기 상환 위험, 시장 변동성을 반영합니다.

segments.src: As a rough illustration: if the 10-year yield rises by half a percentage point and the spread stays the same, mortgage rates often rise by a similar amount.
segments.tr: 대략적인 예로, 10년 만기 국채 수익률이 0.5%포인트 상승하고 스프레드가 동일하게 유지된다면, 주택 담보 대출 금리도 비슷한 수준으로 상승하는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: On a $400,000 loan, a difference of half a percentage point can change the monthly payment by roughly $130 to $150 and add tens of thousands of dollars in interest over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: 40만 달러 대출의 경우, 0.5%포인트의 차이는 월 납입금을 약 130달러에서 150달러까지 변화시킬 수 있으며 대출 기간 동안 수만 달러의 이자를 추가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Actual numbers depend on your lender, credit profile and loan type.
segments.tr: 실제 수치는 대출 기관, 신용 프로필, 대출 유형에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: ### Car Loans
segments.tr: ### 자동차 대출

segments.src: Auto loans are shorter, so they are usually priced off medium-term rates, but they move in the same general direction as Treasury yields.
segments.tr: 자동차 대출은 기간이 더 짧기 때문에 보통 중기 금리를 기준으로 가격이 책정되지만, 국채 수익률과 같은 일반적인 방향으로 움직입니다.

segments.src: Your own rate depends heavily on your credit score, the loan term, the down payment and whether the vehicle is new or used.
segments.tr: 개인의 금리는 신용 점수, 대출 기간, 계약금, 차량의 신차/중고차 여부에 크게 좌우됩니다.

segments.src: When yields rise, lenders' funding costs rise, and offers to consumers tend to follow with a lag.
segments.tr: 수익률이 상승하면 대출 기관의 자금 조달 비용이 상승하며, 소비자에게 제공되는 금리도 시차를 두고 따라가는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Credit Cards and Other Borrowing
segments.tr: ### 신용 카드 및 기타 대출

segments.src: Credit card rates are tied more closely to the Fed's short-term rate than to the 10-year yield.
segments.tr: 신용 카드 금리는 10년 만기 국채 수익률보다 연준의 단기 금리와 더 밀접하게 연관되어 있습니다.

segments.src: Still, home equity loans, student loans from private lenders and small business loans can all be influenced by longer-term benchmarks.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 주택 담보 대출, 민간 대출 기관의 학자금 대출, 소기업 대출은 모두 장기 벤치마크의 영향을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Savings, CDs and Bonds
segments.tr: ### 저축, CD 및 채권

segments.src: There is an upside to higher yields: new savers and bond buyers earn more.
segments.tr: 수익률 상승에는 긍정적인 면도 있습니다: 신규 저축자와 채권 매수자는 더 많은 수익을 얻습니다.

segments.src: Certificates of deposit, bond funds and new Treasury purchases generally offer better returns when yields are higher.
segments.tr: 양도성 예금 증서(CD), 채권 펀드, 신규 국채 매입은 일반적으로 수익률이 높을 때 더 나은 수익을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Existing bonds, however, lose market value when yields rise, which is why bond funds can show temporary losses in such periods.
segments.tr: 그러나 기존 채권은 수익률이 상승하면 시장 가치가 하락하며, 이것이 채권 펀드가 그러한 시기에 일시적인 손실을 보일 수 있는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Your 401(k) and the Stock Market
segments.tr: ## 401(k)와 주식 시장

segments.src: Stocks are valued by estimating future profits and discounting them back to today's dollars.
segments.tr: 주식은 미래 수익을 추정하고 이를 현재 가치로 할인하여 평가됩니다.

segments.src: The discount rate is built on the 10-year Treasury yield.
segments.tr: 할인율은 10년 만기 국채 수익률을 기반으로 합니다.

segments.src: When the yield rises:
segments.tr: 수익률이 상승하면:

segments.src: 1. **Future earnings are worth less today.** This hits growth companies, whose profits are expected further in the future, especially hard.
segments.tr: 1. **미래 수익의 현재 가치가 낮아집니다.** 이는 수익이 먼 미래에 예상되는 성장주에 특히 큰 타격을 줍니다.

segments.src: 2. **Bonds become more competitive.** If a safe Treasury pays a solid yield, investors may demand a larger reward to hold riskier stocks.
segments.tr: 2. **채권의 경쟁력이 높아집니다.** 안전한 국채가 탄탄한 수익률을 제공한다면, 투자자들은 더 위험한 주식을 보유하기 위해 더 큰 보상을 요구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Company borrowing costs increase.** Higher financing costs can squeeze profit margins and slow expansion.
segments.tr: 3. **기업의 차입 비용이 증가합니다.** 높은 자금 조달 비용은 이익 마진을 압박하고 확장을 늦출 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This doesn't mean stocks always fall when yields rise.
segments.tr: 그렇다고 수익률이 오를 때 항상 주가가 하락하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: If yields climb because the economy is strong and earnings are growing, stocks can handle it.
segments.tr: 경제가 강하고 수익이 성장하고 있기 때문에 수익률이 상승하는 것이라면, 주식 시장은 이를 감당할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Trouble tends to come when yields rise quickly for reasons like inflation fears or concerns about government finances.
segments.tr: 문제는 인플레이션 공포나 정부 재정에 대한 우려와 같은 이유로 수익률이 빠르게 상승할 때 발생하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: For long-term 401(k) investors, the practical takeaway is not to react to every daily move.
segments.tr: 장기 401(k) 투자자에게 실질적인 교훈은 매일의 움직임에 반응하지 않는 것입니다.

segments.src: Diversification across stocks, bonds and other assets, a time horizon that matches your goals and regular contributions are generally more important than guessing where yields will go.
segments.tr: 주식, 채권 및 기타 자산에 대한 분산 투자, 목표에 맞는 투자 기간, 그리고 정기적인 납입이 수익률이 어디로 갈지 예측하는 것보다 일반적으로 더 중요합니다.

segments.src: If you hold bond funds in your plan, remember that their price sensitivity to rate changes depends on their **duration**: longer-duration funds move more.
segments.tr: 플랜 내에 채권 펀드를 보유하고 있다면, 금리 변화에 대한 가격 민감도는 **듀레이션(duration)**에 따라 다르다는 점을 기억하십시오: 듀레이션이 긴 펀드가 더 많이 움직입니다.

segments.src: ## Signals to Watch Heading Into December
segments.tr: ## 12월을 앞두고 지켜봐야 할 신호

segments.src: You don't need to track dozens of indicators.
segments.tr: 수십 개의 지표를 추적할 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: These are the ones that tend to matter most:
segments.tr: 가장 중요한 경향이 있는 지표들은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Inflation reports (CPI and PCE).** Hotter-than-expected readings can push yields up; cooler readings can pull them down.
segments.tr: - **인플레이션 보고서(CPI 및 PCE).** 예상보다 뜨거운 수치는 수익률을 밀어 올릴 수 있고, 차가운 수치는 수익률을 끌어내릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The December Fed meeting and its projections.** Pay attention to the statement, the updated economic projections and the chair's comments about the path of rates.
segments.tr: - **12월 연준 회의 및 전망.** 성명서, 업데이트된 경제 전망, 그리고 금리 경로에 대한 의장의 발언에 주목하십시오.

segments.src: - **The jobs report.** Strong hiring and wage growth can signal persistent inflation pressure; a notable slowdown can raise expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - **고용 보고서.** 강력한 고용과 임금 상승은 지속적인 인플레이션 압력을 신호할 수 있으며, 눈에 띄는 둔화는 금리 인하에 대한 기대를 높일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions.** Weak demand at auctions of 10-year and 30-year debt can signal buyers want higher yields.
segments.tr: - **국채 경매.** 10년 및 30년 만기 채권 경매에서의 약한 수요는 매수자들이 더 높은 수익률을 원한다는 신호일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Deficit and debt-ceiling news.** Budget negotiations and projections can affect the term premium.
segments.tr: - **적자 및 부채 한도 뉴스.** 예산 협상과 전망은 기간 프리미엄에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The mortgage-to-Treasury spread.** If it narrows, borrowers may get some relief even without a drop in yields.
segments.tr: - **주택 담보 대출과 국채 간의 스프레드.** 이 격차가 좁아지면 수익률 하락 없이도 대출자들은 어느 정도 안도감을 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **The yield curve.** The gap between short-term and long-term yields offers clues about growth and rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **수익률 곡선.** 단기 수익률과 장기 수익률 간의 격차는 성장과 금리 기대에 대한 단서를 제공합니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for Households
segments.tr: ## 가계를 위한 실질적인 단계

segments.src: - **If you're shopping for a mortgage:** Compare quotes from several lenders on the same day, ask about rate locks, and consider how long you plan to stay in the home before paying for points.
segments.tr: - **주택 담보 대출을 알아보고 있다면:** 같은 날 여러 대출 기관의 견적을 비교하고, 금리 고정(rate locks)에 대해 문의하며, 포인트를 지불하기 전에 집에 얼마나 오래 거주할 계획인지 고려하십시오.

segments.src: - **If you already have a fixed-rate mortgage:** A rate movement matters mainly if you are considering refinancing. Run the numbers including closing costs and your break-even time.
segments.tr: - **이미 고정 금리 주택 담보 대출이 있다면:** 금리 변동은 주로 재융자를 고려할 때 중요합니다. 마감 비용과 손익분기점을 포함하여 계산해 보십시오.

segments.src: - **If you're financing a vehicle:** Check your credit report, get pre-approved by a bank or credit union, and compare the total cost, not just the monthly payment.
segments.tr: - **차량을 할부로 구매한다면:** 신용 보고서를 확인하고, 은행이나 신용협동조합에서 사전 승인을 받으며, 월 납입금뿐만 아니라 총비용을 비교하십시오.

segments.src: - **If you're investing for retirement:** Keep your allocation aligned with your risk tolerance and timeline. Rebalance on a schedule rather than in response to headlines.
segments.tr: - **은퇴를 위해 투자한다면:** 위험 감수 성향과 기간에 맞춰 자산 배분을 유지하십시오. 뉴스 헤드라인에 반응하기보다는 일정에 따라 리밸런싱하십시오.

segments.src: - **If you have cash to save:** Compare yields on high-yield savings, CDs and Treasuries, including the state-tax treatment of Treasury interest.
segments.tr: - **저축할 현금이 있다면:** 고금리 예금, CD, 국채의 수익률을 비교하고, 국채 이자에 대한 주세 처리 여부도 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is a quiet benchmark with a loud influence.
segments.tr: 10년 만기 국채 수익률은 조용하지만 강력한 영향력을 가진 벤치마크입니다.

segments.src: It reflects how the market sees inflation, growth, government borrowing and the Fed's next steps, and it feeds directly into the price of mortgages, car loans and stock valuations.
segments.tr: 이는 시장이 인플레이션, 성장, 정부 차입, 그리고 연준의 다음 단계를 어떻게 보는지 반영하며, 주택 담보 대출, 자동차 대출, 주식 가치 평가 가격에 직접적으로 반영됩니다.

segments.src: You don't have to watch it every day.
segments.tr: 매일 지켜볼 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: Knowing what moves it, and checking in around key events like inflation data and the December Fed meeting, can help you time big financial decisions with a clearer view of the forces behind your borrowing costs and investment returns.
segments.tr: 무엇이 수익률을 움직이는지 알고, 인플레이션 데이터나 12월 연준 회의와 같은 주요 이벤트 전후로 확인하는 것은 차입 비용과 투자 수익의 이면에 있는 힘을 더 명확하게 파악하여 큰 재무적 결정을 내리는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

zh.title: 解读10年期美国国债收益率：为何它对抵押贷款、汽车贷款和您的401(k)养老金账户至关重要

segments.src: Most people never check the 10-year Treasury yield.
segments.tr: 大多数人从不查看10年期美国国债收益率。

segments.src: Yet it influences the interest rate on a home loan, the cost of financing a car and the value of the stocks inside a retirement account.
segments.tr: 然而，它却影响着住房贷款利率、汽车融资成本以及退休账户中股票的价值。

segments.src: With heavy government borrowing, lingering inflation worries and changing expectations about the Federal Reserve, this number keeps showing up in financial headlines.
segments.tr: 随着政府借贷规模庞大、通胀担忧挥之不去以及对美联储预期的不断变化，这个数字频频出现在财经头条中。

segments.src: This guide explains what it is, why it matters and what to watch as December approaches.
segments.tr: 本指南将解释它是什么、为何重要，以及随着12月的临近需要关注什么。

segments.src: *This article is for general education only.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般教育参考。

segments.src: It is not personal financial advice.
segments.tr: 它不构成个人理财建议。

segments.src: Rates and market conditions change, so check current figures and consider talking with a qualified professional before making decisions.*
segments.tr: 利率和市场状况会发生变化，因此在做出决定前，请查看当前数据并考虑咨询合格的专业人士。*

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Actually Is
segments.tr: ## 10年期国债收益率究竟是什么

segments.src: When the U.S.
segments.tr: 当美国

segments.src: government needs to borrow money, it sells Treasury securities.
segments.tr: 政府需要借钱时，它会出售国债。

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is a loan to the government that pays interest for ten years and then returns the original amount.
segments.tr: 10年期国债是一种借给政府的贷款，支付十年利息，到期后归还本金。

segments.src: The **yield** is the annual return an investor earns if they buy the note at today's market price and hold it to maturity.
segments.tr: “**收益率**”是指投资者如果以当前市场价格买入该国债并持有至到期所获得的年化回报。

segments.src: Two things are worth remembering:
segments.tr: 有两点值得记住：

segments.src: - **Prices and yields move in opposite directions.** If investors want more Treasuries, prices rise and yields fall. If they sell, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: - **价格和收益率呈反向变动。** 如果投资者想要更多的国债，价格就会上涨，收益率就会下降。如果他们抛售，价格就会下跌，收益率就会上升。

segments.src: - **The yield is set by the market, not by the Fed.** The Federal Reserve controls a short-term policy rate. The 10-year yield reflects what millions of investors collectively expect for growth, inflation and policy over the next decade.
segments.tr: - **收益率由市场决定，而非美联储。** 美联储控制的是短期政策利率。10年期国债收益率反映了数百万投资者对未来十年经济增长、通胀和政策的集体预期。

segments.src: Because U.S.
segments.tr: 由于美国

segments.src: Treasuries are considered among the safest investments in the world, their yield serves as a baseline, often called the "risk-free rate."
segments.tr: 国债被认为是世界上最安全的投资之一，其收益率被用作基准，通常被称为“无风险利率”。

segments.src: Almost every other interest rate is priced as that baseline plus extra for risk.
segments.tr: 几乎所有其他利率都是以该基准加上风险溢价来定价的。

segments.src: ## Why Government Borrowing Pushes on Yields
segments.tr: ## 为什么政府借贷会推高收益率

segments.src: The federal government has been running large annual deficits, which means it must keep issuing new debt.
segments.tr: 联邦政府一直存在巨额年度赤字，这意味着它必须不断发行新债。

segments.src: A bigger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract enough buyers, especially if demand from big holders doesn't keep pace.
segments.tr: 国债供应量增加可能需要更高的收益率来吸引足够的买家，特别是如果大持有者的需求没有跟上的话。

segments.src: Investors also pay attention to the **term premium**, the extra compensation they ask for locking money up for ten years instead of rolling over short-term securities.
segments.tr: 投资者还会关注**期限溢价**，即他们要求为锁定十年资金而非滚动短期证券而获得的额外补偿。

segments.src: When uncertainty about deficits, inflation or policy rises, the term premium can rise too, lifting long-term yields even if the Fed isn't changing its own rate.
segments.tr: 当对赤字、通胀或政策的不确定性上升时，期限溢价也可能上升，从而推高长期收益率，即使美联储没有改变其自身利率。

segments.src: ## The Inflation Connection
segments.tr: ## 通胀的关联

segments.src: Inflation erodes the purchasing power of fixed interest payments.
segments.tr: 通胀会侵蚀固定利息支付的购买力。

segments.src: If investors expect prices to rise faster, they demand a higher yield to make up for it.
segments.tr: 如果投资者预期价格上涨更快，他们会要求更高的收益率来弥补。

segments.src: That is why inflation reports, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, can move the 10-year yield sharply on the day they are released.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么通胀报告（如消费者价格指数 (CPI) 和个人消费支出 (PCE) 价格指数）在发布当天会使10年期国债收益率剧烈波动的原因。

segments.src: A useful way to think about it is the **real yield**: the nominal yield minus expected inflation.
segments.tr: 一个有用的思考方式是**实际收益率**：名义收益率减去预期通胀。

segments.src: Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) give a market-based view of this.
segments.tr: 通胀保值债券 (TIPS) 提供了一个基于市场的视角。

segments.src: A rising real yield means borrowing is becoming more expensive in inflation-adjusted terms, which tends to weigh on the economy and on stock valuations.
segments.tr: 实际收益率上升意味着经通胀调整后的借贷成本正在变得更加昂贵，这往往会对经济和股票估值造成压力。

segments.src: ## How the Fed Fits In
segments.tr: ## 美联储的角色

segments.src: The Fed sets short-term rates, but the 10-year yield tries to anticipate where those rates are headed.
segments.tr: 美联储设定短期利率，但10年期国债收益率试图预测这些利率的走向。

segments.src: If markets expect rate cuts, long-term yields often drift lower.
segments.tr: 如果市场预期降息，长期收益率往往会走低。

segments.src: If the Fed signals it may hold rates higher for longer, or if inflation data surprises to the upside, yields can climb.
segments.tr: 如果美联储暗示可能在更长时间内维持高利率，或者通胀数据意外走高，收益率就会攀升。

segments.src: Sometimes the two move in different directions.
segments.tr: 有时两者会向不同方向移动。

segments.src: A Fed rate cut does not automatically lower mortgage rates.
segments.tr: 美联储降息并不会自动降低抵押贷款利率。

segments.src: If investors worry about inflation or deficits at the same time, long-term yields can stay elevated or even rise.
segments.tr: 如果投资者同时担心通胀或赤字，长期收益率可能会保持高位甚至上升。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## 这对您的钱包意味着什么

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### 抵押贷款

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not follow the Fed directly.
segments.tr: 30年期固定抵押贷款利率并不直接跟随美联储。

segments.src: It tracks the 10-year Treasury yield closely, usually sitting meaningfully above it.
segments.tr: 它紧密跟踪10年期国债收益率，通常显著高于后者。

segments.src: The gap, called the **spread**, reflects lender costs, prepayment risk and market volatility.
segments.tr: 这种差距称为**利差**，反映了贷款机构的成本、提前还款风险和市场波动性。

segments.src: As a rough illustration: if the 10-year yield rises by half a percentage point and the spread stays the same, mortgage rates often rise by a similar amount.
segments.tr: 粗略说明：如果10年期国债收益率上升0.5个百分点，且利差保持不变，抵押贷款利率通常也会上升类似的幅度。

segments.src: On a $400,000 loan, a difference of half a percentage point can change the monthly payment by roughly $130 to $150 and add tens of thousands of dollars in interest over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: 对于40万美元的贷款，0.5个百分点的差异可能会使月供增加约130至150美元，并在贷款期限内增加数万美元的利息支出。

segments.src: Actual numbers depend on your lender, credit profile and loan type.
segments.tr: 实际数字取决于您的贷款机构、信用状况和贷款类型。

segments.src: ### Car Loans
segments.tr: ### 汽车贷款

segments.src: Auto loans are shorter, so they are usually priced off medium-term rates, but they move in the same general direction as Treasury yields.
segments.tr: 汽车贷款期限较短，因此通常以中期利率定价，但它们的变动方向与国债收益率大致相同。

segments.src: Your own rate depends heavily on your credit score, the loan term, the down payment and whether the vehicle is new or used.
segments.tr: 您个人的利率很大程度上取决于您的信用评分、贷款期限、首付金额以及车辆是新车还是二手车。

segments.src: When yields rise, lenders' funding costs rise, and offers to consumers tend to follow with a lag.
segments.tr: 当收益率上升时，贷款机构的融资成本上升，提供给消费者的利率往往会滞后跟进。

segments.src: ### Credit Cards and Other Borrowing
segments.tr: ### 信用卡和其他借贷

segments.src: Credit card rates are tied more closely to the Fed's short-term rate than to the 10-year yield.
segments.tr: 信用卡利率与美联储的短期利率挂钩比与10年期国债收益率挂钩更紧密。

segments.src: Still, home equity loans, student loans from private lenders and small business loans can all be influenced by longer-term benchmarks.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，房屋净值贷款、私人贷款机构的学生贷款和小企业贷款都可能受到长期基准利率的影响。

segments.src: ### Savings, CDs and Bonds
segments.tr: ### 储蓄、存单和债券

segments.src: There is an upside to higher yields: new savers and bond buyers earn more.
segments.tr: 高收益率也有积极的一面：新的储蓄者和债券购买者可以获得更多收益。

segments.src: Certificates of deposit, bond funds and new Treasury purchases generally offer better returns when yields are higher.
segments.tr: 当收益率较高时，存单、债券基金和新购买的国债通常提供更好的回报。

segments.src: Existing bonds, however, lose market value when yields rise, which is why bond funds can show temporary losses in such periods.
segments.tr: 然而，现有债券在收益率上升时会损失市场价值，这就是为什么债券基金在此类时期可能会出现暂时性亏损。

segments.src: ## Your 401(k) and the Stock Market
segments.tr: ## 您的401(k)和股票市场

segments.src: Stocks are valued by estimating future profits and discounting them back to today's dollars.
segments.tr: 股票的估值是通过估算未来利润并将其折现回今天的美元价值来确定的。

segments.src: The discount rate is built on the 10-year Treasury yield.
segments.tr: 折现率建立在10年期国债收益率的基础上。

segments.src: When the yield rises:
segments.tr: 当收益率上升时：

segments.src: 1. **Future earnings are worth less today.** This hits growth companies, whose profits are expected further in the future, especially hard.
segments.tr: 1. **未来收益在今天的价值降低。** 这对成长型公司打击尤为严重，因为它们的利润预期在更遥远的未来。

segments.src: 2. **Bonds become more competitive.** If a safe Treasury pays a solid yield, investors may demand a larger reward to hold riskier stocks.
segments.tr: 2. **债券变得更具竞争力。** 如果安全的国债支付稳健的收益率，投资者可能会要求更高的回报才愿意持有风险更高的股票。

segments.src: 3. **Company borrowing costs increase.** Higher financing costs can squeeze profit margins and slow expansion.
segments.tr: 3. **公司借贷成本增加。** 更高的融资成本会压缩利润率并减缓扩张。

segments.src: This doesn't mean stocks always fall when yields rise.
segments.tr: 这并不意味着股票在收益率上升时总是下跌。

segments.src: If yields climb because the economy is strong and earnings are growing, stocks can handle it.
segments.tr: 如果收益率攀升是因为经济强劲且盈利增长，股票是可以承受的。

segments.src: Trouble tends to come when yields rise quickly for reasons like inflation fears or concerns about government finances.
segments.tr: 当收益率因通胀担忧或政府财政担忧等原因快速上升时，往往会出现问题。

segments.src: For long-term 401(k) investors, the practical takeaway is not to react to every daily move.
segments.tr: 对于长期的401(k)投资者来说，实际的启示是不要对每一次日常波动做出反应。

segments.src: Diversification across stocks, bonds and other assets, a time horizon that matches your goals and regular contributions are generally more important than guessing where yields will go.
segments.tr: 跨股票、债券和其他资产的多元化配置、符合您目标的时间跨度以及定期缴款，通常比猜测收益率走向更重要。

segments.src: If you hold bond funds in your plan, remember that their price sensitivity to rate changes depends on their **duration**: longer-duration funds move more.
segments.tr: 如果您在计划中持有债券基金，请记住它们对利率变化的价格敏感度取决于其**久期**：久期较长的基金波动更大。

segments.src: ## Signals to Watch Heading Into December
segments.tr: ## 迈向12月需要关注的信号

segments.src: You don't need to track dozens of indicators.
segments.tr: 您不需要追踪几十个指标。

segments.src: These are the ones that tend to matter most:
segments.tr: 以下这些往往是最重要的：

segments.src: - **Inflation reports (CPI and PCE).** Hotter-than-expected readings can push yields up; cooler readings can pull them down.
segments.tr: - **通胀报告 (CPI 和 PCE)。** 高于预期的读数可能会推高收益率；较低的读数可能会拉低收益率。

segments.src: - **The December Fed meeting and its projections.** Pay attention to the statement, the updated economic projections and the chair's comments about the path of rates.
segments.tr: - **12月美联储会议及其预测。** 关注声明、更新的经济预测以及主席关于利率路径的评论。

segments.src: - **The jobs report.** Strong hiring and wage growth can signal persistent inflation pressure; a notable slowdown can raise expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - **就业报告。** 强劲的招聘和工资增长可能预示着持续的通胀压力；显著放缓可能会提高降息预期。

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions.** Weak demand at auctions of 10-year and 30-year debt can signal buyers want higher yields.
segments.tr: - **国债拍卖。** 10年期和30年期国债拍卖需求疲软可能预示着买家想要更高的收益率。

segments.src: - **Deficit and debt-ceiling news.** Budget negotiations and projections can affect the term premium.
segments.tr: - **赤字和债务上限新闻。** 预算谈判和预测可能会影响期限溢价。

segments.src: - **The mortgage-to-Treasury spread.** If it narrows, borrowers may get some relief even without a drop in yields.
segments.tr: - **抵押贷款与国债的利差。** 如果利差缩小，即使收益率没有下降，借款人也可能获得一些缓解。

segments.src: - **The yield curve.** The gap between short-term and long-term yields offers clues about growth and rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **收益率曲线。** 短期和长期收益率之间的差距提供了关于增长和利率预期的线索。

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for Households
segments.tr: ## 家庭的实际步骤

segments.src: - **If you're shopping for a mortgage:** Compare quotes from several lenders on the same day, ask about rate locks, and consider how long you plan to stay in the home before paying for points.
segments.tr: - **如果您正在寻找抵押贷款：** 在同一天比较多家贷款机构的报价，询问利率锁定，并考虑在支付点数之前您计划在房子里住多久。

segments.src: - **If you already have a fixed-rate mortgage:** A rate movement matters mainly if you are considering refinancing. Run the numbers including closing costs and your break-even time.
segments.tr: - **如果您已经有固定利率抵押贷款：** 利率变动主要在您考虑再融资时才有意义。计算包括过户费和您的盈亏平衡时间在内的数字。

segments.src: - **If you're financing a vehicle:** Check your credit report, get pre-approved by a bank or credit union, and compare the total cost, not just the monthly payment.
segments.tr: - **如果您正在为车辆融资：** 检查您的信用报告，从银行或信用社获得预先批准，并比较总成本，而不仅仅是月供。

segments.src: - **If you're investing for retirement:** Keep your allocation aligned with your risk tolerance and timeline. Rebalance on a schedule rather than in response to headlines.
segments.tr: - **如果您正在为退休投资：** 保持您的资产配置与您的风险承受能力和时间表一致。按计划重新平衡，而不是为了应对头条新闻。

segments.src: - **If you have cash to save:** Compare yields on high-yield savings, CDs and Treasuries, including the state-tax treatment of Treasury interest.
segments.tr: - **如果您有现金需要储蓄：** 比较高收益储蓄、存单和国债的收益率，包括国债利息的州税待遇。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is a quiet benchmark with a loud influence.
segments.tr: 10年期国债收益率是一个安静但影响巨大的基准。

segments.src: It reflects how the market sees inflation, growth, government borrowing and the Fed's next steps, and it feeds directly into the price of mortgages, car loans and stock valuations.
segments.tr: 它反映了市场如何看待通胀、增长、政府借贷和美联储的下一步行动，并直接影响抵押贷款、汽车贷款和股票估值的价格。

segments.src: You don't have to watch it every day.
segments.tr: 您不必每天都盯着它看。

segments.src: Knowing what moves it, and checking in around key events like inflation data and the December Fed meeting, can help you time big financial decisions with a clearer view of the forces behind your borrowing costs and investment returns.
segments.tr: 了解是什么推动了它，并在通胀数据和12月美联储会议等关键事件前后查看一下，可以帮助您在更清晰地了解借贷成本和投资回报背后的力量的情况下，做出重大的财务决策。

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Actually Is
segments.tr: ## 10-वर्षीय यील्ड वास्तव में क्या है

segments.src: When the U.S.
segments.tr: जब अमेरिकी

segments.src: government needs to borrow money, it sells Treasury securities.
segments.tr: सरकार को पैसे उधार लेने की आवश्यकता होती है, तो यह ट्रेजरी प्रतिभूतियों (सिक्योरिटीज) को बेचती है।

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is a loan to the government that pays interest for ten years and then returns the original amount.
segments.tr: 10-वर्षीय ट्रेजरी नोट सरकार को दिया जाने वाला एक ऋण है जो दस वर्षों तक ब्याज का भुगतान करता है और फिर मूल राशि वापस करता है।

segments.src: The **yield** is the annual return an investor earns if they buy the note at today's market price and hold it to maturity.
segments.tr: यह **यील्ड** (प्रतिफल) वह वार्षिक रिटर्न है जो एक निवेशक को तब मिलता है जब वे आज की बाजार कीमत पर नोट खरीदते हैं और इसे परिपक्वता (मैच्योरिटी) तक रखते हैं।

segments.src: Two things are worth remembering:
segments.tr: दो बातें याद रखने योग्य हैं:

segments.src: - **Prices and yields move in opposite directions.** If investors want more Treasuries, prices rise and yields fall. If they sell, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: - **कीमतें और यील्ड विपरीत दिशाओं में चलते हैं।** यदि निवेशक अधिक ट्रेजरी चाहते हैं, तो कीमतें बढ़ती हैं और यील्ड गिरती है। यदि वे बेचते हैं, तो कीमतें गिरती हैं और यील्ड बढ़ती है।

segments.src: - **The yield is set by the market, not by the Fed.** The Federal Reserve controls a short-term policy rate. The 10-year yield reflects what millions of investors collectively expect for growth, inflation and policy over the next decade.
segments.tr: - **यील्ड बाजार द्वारा तय की जाती है, फेड द्वारा नहीं।** फेडरल रिजर्व अल्पकालिक नीति दर को नियंत्रित करता है। 10-वर्षीय यील्ड दर्शाती है कि लाखों निवेशक सामूहिक रूप से अगले दशक के लिए विकास, मुद्रास्फीति और नीति की क्या अपेक्षा करते हैं।

segments.src: Because U.S.
segments.tr: चूँकि अमेरिकी

segments.src: Treasuries are considered among the safest investments in the world, their yield serves as a baseline, often called the "risk-free rate."
segments.tr: ट्रेजरी को दुनिया में सबसे सुरक्षित निवेशों में गिना जाता है, इसलिए इनकी यील्ड एक आधार रेखा (बेसलाइन) के रूप में कार्य करती है, जिसे अक्सर "जोखिम-मुक्त दर" कहा जाता है।

segments.src: Almost every other interest rate is priced as that baseline plus extra for risk.
segments.tr: लगभग हर दूसरी ब्याज दर को उस आधार रेखा के रूप में और जोखिम के लिए अतिरिक्त रूप में मूल्यवान किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## Why Government Borrowing Pushes on Yields
segments.tr: ## सरकारी उधार यील्ड को कैसे प्रभावित करता है

segments.src: The federal government has been running large annual deficits, which means it must keep issuing new debt.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार बड़े वार्षिक घाटे के साथ चल रही है, जिसका अर्थ है कि उसे नए ऋण जारी रखना होगा।

segments.src: A bigger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract enough buyers, especially if demand from big holders doesn't keep pace.
segments.tr: ट्रेजरी की बड़ी आपूर्ति के लिए पर्याप्त खरीदारों को आकर्षित करने हेतु उच्च यील्ड की आवश्यकता हो सकती है, खासकर यदि बड़े धारकों से मांग तालमेल न बिठा पाए।

segments.src: Investors also pay attention to the **term premium**, the extra compensation they ask for locking money up for ten years instead of rolling over short-term securities.
segments.tr: निवेशक **टर्म प्रीमियम** पर भी ध्यान देते हैं, जो अल्पकालिक प्रतिभूतियों को रोलओवर करने के बजाय दस वर्षों के लिए धन को लॉक करने के लिए उनके द्वारा मांगी जाने वाली अतिरिक्त क्षतिपूर्ति है।

segments.src: When uncertainty about deficits, inflation or policy rises, the term premium can rise too, lifting long-term yields even if the Fed isn't changing its own rate.
segments.tr: जब घाटे, मुद्रास्फीति या नीति के बारे में अनिश्चितता बढ़ती है, तो टर्म प्रीमियम भी बढ़ सकता है, जिससे लंबी अवधि की यील्ड और ऊपर उठ जाती है, भले ही फेड अपनी दर में बदलाव न कर रहा हो।

segments.src: ## The Inflation Connection
segments.tr: ## मुद्रास्फीति का संबंध

segments.src: Inflation erodes the purchasing power of fixed interest payments.
segments.tr: मुद्रास्फीति निश्चित ब्याज भुगतानों की क्रय शक्ति को कम करती है।

segments.src: If investors expect prices to rise faster, they demand a higher yield to make up for it.
segments.tr: यदि निवेशकों को कीमतें तेजी से बढ़ने की उम्मीद है, तो वे इसकी भरपाई के लिए उच्च यील्ड की मांग करते हैं।

segments.src: That is why inflation reports, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, can move the 10-year yield sharply on the day they are released.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि मुद्रास्फीति की रिपोर्टें, जैसे कि उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) और व्यक्तिगत उपभोग व्यय (PCE) मूल्य सूचकांक, जारी होने के दिन 10-वर्षीय यील्ड को तेजी से बदल सकती हैं।

segments.src: A useful way to think about it is the **real yield**: the nominal yield minus expected inflation.
segments.tr: इसके बारे में सोचने का एक उपयोगी तरीका **वास्तविक यील्ड (रियल यील्ड)** है: नाममात्र यील्ड (नॉमिनल यील्ड) माइनस अपेक्षित मुद्रास्फीति।

segments.src: Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) give a market-based view of this.
segments.tr: ट्रेजरी इन्फ्लेशन-प्रोटेक्टेड सिक्योरिटीज (TIPS) इसका बाजार-आधारित दृष्टिकोण देती हैं।

segments.src: A rising real yield means borrowing is becoming more expensive in inflation-adjusted terms, which tends to weigh on the economy and on stock valuations.
segments.tr: बढ़ती वास्तविक यील्ड का मतलब है कि मुद्रास्फीति-समायोजित संदर्भ में उधार लेना अधिक महंगा हो रहा है, जो अर्थव्यवस्था और स्टॉक मूल्यांकन पर भारी पड़ता है।

segments.src: ## How the Fed Fits In
segments.tr: ## फेड इसमें कैसे फिट बैठता है

segments.src: The Fed sets short-term rates, but the 10-year yield tries to anticipate where those rates are headed.
segments.tr: फेड अल्पकालिक दरें तय करता है, लेकिन 10-वर्षीय यील्ड यह अनुमान लगाने की कोशिश करती है कि वे दरें कहाँ जा रही हैं।

segments.src: If markets expect rate cuts, long-term yields often drift lower.
segments.tr: यदि बाजार दर में कटौती की उम्मीद करते हैं, तो दीर्घकालिक यील्ड अक्सर नीचे की ओर खिसक जाती है।

segments.src: If the Fed signals it may hold rates higher for longer, or if inflation data surprises to the upside, yields can climb.
segments.tr: यदि फेड संकेत देता है कि वह दरों को लंबे समय तक उच्च रख सकता है, या यदि मुद्रास्फीति के आंकड़े ऊपर की ओर आश्चर्यचकित करते हैं, तो यील्ड बढ़ सकती है।

segments.src: Sometimes the two move in different directions.
segments.tr: कभी-कभी दोनों अलग-अलग दिशाओं में चलते हैं।

segments.src: A Fed rate cut does not automatically lower mortgage rates.
segments.tr: फेड द्वारा दर में कटौती से स्वचालित रूप से बंधक (मॉर्गेज) दरें कम नहीं होती हैं।

segments.src: If investors worry about inflation or deficits at the same time, long-term yields can stay elevated or even rise.
segments.tr: यदि निवेशक एक ही समय में मुद्रास्फीति या घाटे के बारे में चिंतित हैं, तो दीर्घकालिक यील्ड ऊंची बनी रह सकती है या बढ़ भी सकती है।

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## आपके बटुए के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### बंधक (मॉर्गेज)

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not follow the Fed directly.
segments.tr: 30-वर्षीय निश्चित बंधक दर सीधे फेड का अनुसरण नहीं करती है।

segments.src: It tracks the 10-year Treasury yield closely, usually sitting meaningfully above it.
segments.tr: यह 10-वर्षीय ट्रेजरी यील्ड को करीब से ट्रैक करती है, जो आमतौर पर इसके काफी ऊपर रहती है।

segments.src: The gap, called the **spread**, reflects lender costs, prepayment risk and market volatility.
segments.tr: इस अंतर को, जिसे **स्प्रेड** कहा जाता है, ऋणदाता की लागत, पूर्व-भुगतान जोखिम और बाजार की अस्थिरता को दर्शाता है।

segments.src: As a rough illustration: if the 10-year yield rises by half a percentage point and the spread stays the same, mortgage rates often rise by a similar amount.
segments.tr: एक मोटे उदाहरण के रूप में: यदि 10-वर्षीय यील्ड आधे प्रतिशत अंक बढ़ जाती है और स्प्रेड वही रहता है, तो बंधक दरें अक्सर समान राशि से बढ़ जाती हैं।

segments.src: On a $400,000 loan, a difference of half a percentage point can change the monthly payment by roughly $130 to $150 and add tens of thousands of dollars in interest over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: $400,000 के ऋण पर, आधे प्रतिशत अंक का अंतर मासिक भुगतान को लगभग $130 से $150 तक बदल सकता है और ऋण की अवधि में हजारों डॉलर का ब्याज जोड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Actual numbers depend on your lender, credit profile and loan type.
segments.tr: वास्तविक संख्याएं आपके ऋणदाता, क्रेडिट प्रोफ़ाइल और ऋण प्रकार पर निर्भर करती हैं।

segments.src: ### Car Loans
segments.tr: ### कार लोन

segments.src: Auto loans are shorter, so they are usually priced off medium-term rates, but they move in the same general direction as Treasury yields.
segments.tr: ऑटो लोन छोटे होते हैं, इसलिए वे आमतौर पर मध्यम अवधि की दरों पर मूल्यवान होते हैं, लेकिन वे ट्रेजरी यील्ड की समान सामान्य दिशा में चलते हैं।

segments.src: Your own rate depends heavily on your credit score, the loan term, the down payment and whether the vehicle is new or used.
segments.tr: आपकी अपनी दर आपके क्रेडिट स्कोर, ऋण अवधि, डाउन पेमेंट और इस बात पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करती है कि वाहन नया है या पुराना।

segments.src: When yields rise, lenders' funding costs rise, and offers to consumers tend to follow with a lag.
segments.tr: जब यील्ड बढ़ती है, तो ऋणदाताओं की फंडिंग लागत बढ़ जाती है, और उपभोक्ताओं को मिलने वाले ऑफर अंतराल के साथ इसका अनुसरण करते हैं।

segments.src: ### Credit Cards and Other Borrowing
segments.tr: ### क्रेडिट कार्ड और अन्य उधार

segments.src: Credit card rates are tied more closely to the Fed's short-term rate than to the 10-year yield.
segments.tr: क्रेडिट कार्ड की दरें 10-वर्षीय यील्ड की तुलना में फेड की अल्पकालिक दर से अधिक निकटता से जुड़ी होती हैं।

segments.src: Still, home equity loans, student loans from private lenders and small business loans can all be influenced by longer-term benchmarks.
segments.tr: फिर भी, होम इक्विटी लोन, निजी ऋणदाताओं से छात्र ऋण और छोटे व्यवसाय ऋण सभी लंबी अवधि के बेंचमार्क से प्रभावित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: ### Savings, CDs and Bonds
segments.tr: ### बचत, सीडी और बॉन्ड

segments.src: There is an upside to higher yields: new savers and bond buyers earn more.
segments.tr: उच्च यील्ड का एक सकारात्मक पक्ष है: नए बचतकर्ताओं और बॉन्ड खरीदारों को अधिक कमाई होती है।

segments.src: Certificates of deposit, bond funds and new Treasury purchases generally offer better returns when yields are higher.
segments.tr: डिपॉजिट के सर्टिफिकेट (CDs), बॉन्ड फंड और नई ट्रेजरी खरीद आम तौर पर बेहतर रिटर्न देती हैं जब यील्ड अधिक होती है।

segments.src: Existing bonds, however, lose market value when yields rise, which is why bond funds can show temporary losses in such periods.
segments.tr: हालाँकि, मौजूदा बॉन्ड यील्ड बढ़ने पर बाजार मूल्य खो देते हैं, यही वजह है कि बॉन्ड फंड ऐसी अवधि में अस्थायी नुकसान दिखा सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Your 401(k) and the Stock Market
segments.tr: ## आपका 401(k) और स्टॉक मार्केट

segments.src: Stocks are valued by estimating future profits and discounting them back to today's dollars.
segments.tr: स्टॉक का मूल्यांकन भविष्य के मुनाफे का अनुमान लगाकर और उन्हें आज के डॉलर में वापस छूट (डिस्काउंट) देकर किया जाता है।

segments.src: The discount rate is built on the 10-year Treasury yield.
segments.tr: डिस्काउंट दर 10-वर्षीय ट्रेजरी यील्ड पर आधारित होती है।

segments.src: When the yield rises:
segments.tr: जब यील्ड बढ़ती है:

segments.src: 1. **Future earnings are worth less today.** This hits growth companies, whose profits are expected further in the future, especially hard.
segments.tr: 1. **भविष्य की कमाई आज कम मूल्य की है।** यह विकास कंपनियों पर भारी पड़ता है, जिनका मुनाफा भविष्य में और अधिक होने की उम्मीद है, विशेष रूप से कठिन।

segments.src: 2. **Bonds become more competitive.** If a safe Treasury pays a solid yield, investors may demand a larger reward to hold riskier stocks.
segments.tr: 2. **बॉन्ड अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धी बन जाते हैं।** यदि एक सुरक्षित ट्रेजरी ठोस यील्ड का भुगतान करता है, तो निवेशक जोखिम भरे शेयरों को रखने के लिए बड़े पुरस्कार की मांग कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: 3. **Company borrowing costs increase.** Higher financing costs can squeeze profit margins and slow expansion.
segments.tr: 3. **कंपनी के उधार लेने की लागत बढ़ जाती है।** उच्च वित्तपोषण लागत लाभ मार्जिन को निचोड़ सकती है और विस्तार को धीमा कर सकती है।

segments.src: This doesn't mean stocks always fall when yields rise.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि यील्ड बढ़ने पर स्टॉक हमेशा गिरते हैं।

segments.src: If yields climb because the economy is strong and earnings are growing, stocks can handle it.
segments.tr: यदि अर्थव्यवस्था मजबूत होने और कमाई बढ़ने के कारण यील्ड बढ़ती है, तो स्टॉक इसे संभाल सकते हैं।

segments.src: Trouble tends to come when yields rise quickly for reasons like inflation fears or concerns about government finances.
segments.tr: परेशानी तब आती है जब मुद्रास्फीति के डर या सरकार के वित्त के बारे में चिंताओं जैसे कारणों से यील्ड तेजी से बढ़ती है।

segments.src: For long-term 401(k) investors, the practical takeaway is not to react to every daily move.
segments.tr: दीर्घकालिक 401(k) निवेशकों के लिए, व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष यह है कि हर दैनिक चाल पर प्रतिक्रिया न दें।

segments.src: Diversification across stocks, bonds and other assets, a time horizon that matches your goals and regular contributions are generally more important than guessing where yields will go.
segments.tr: स्टॉक, बॉन्ड और अन्य परिसंपत्तियों में विविधीकरण, एक समय क्षितिज जो आपके लक्ष्यों से मेल खाता हो और नियमित योगदान आम तौर पर यह अनुमान लगाने से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण हैं कि यील्ड कहाँ जाएगी।

segments.src: If you hold bond funds in your plan, remember that their price sensitivity to rate changes depends on their **duration**: longer-duration funds move more.
segments.tr: यदि आप अपनी योजना में बॉन्ड फंड रखते हैं, तो याद रखें कि दर परिवर्तनों के प्रति उनकी मूल्य संवेदनशीलता उनकी **अवधि (ड्यूरेशन)** पर निर्भर करती है: लंबी अवधि के फंड अधिक चलते हैं।

segments.src: ## Signals to Watch Heading Into December
segments.tr: ## दिसंबर में प्रवेश करते समय देखने योग्य संकेत

segments.src: You don't need to track dozens of indicators.
segments.tr: आपको दर्जनों संकेतकों को ट्रैक करने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: These are the ones that tend to matter most:
segments.tr: ये वे हैं जो सबसे अधिक मायने रखते हैं:

segments.src: - **Inflation reports (CPI and PCE).** Hotter-than-expected readings can push yields up; cooler readings can pull them down.
segments.tr: - **मुद्रास्फीति रिपोर्ट (CPI और PCE)।** अपेक्षा से अधिक गर्म रीडिंग यील्ड को ऊपर धकेल सकती है; ठंडी रीडिंग उन्हें नीचे खींच सकती है।

segments.src: - **The December Fed meeting and its projections.** Pay attention to the statement, the updated economic projections and the chair's comments about the path of rates.
segments.tr: - **दिसंबर फेड बैठक और इसके अनुमान।** बयान, अद्यतन आर्थिक अनुमान और दरों के मार्ग के बारे में अध्यक्ष की टिप्पणियों पर ध्यान दें।

segments.src: - **The jobs report.** Strong hiring and wage growth can signal persistent inflation pressure; a notable slowdown can raise expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - **नौकरी रिपोर्ट।** मजबूत नियुक्ति और वेतन वृद्धि लगातार मुद्रास्फीति के दबाव का संकेत दे सकती है; एक उल्लेखनीय मंदी दर में कटौती की उम्मीदों को बढ़ा सकती है।

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions.** Weak demand at auctions of 10-year and 30-year debt can signal buyers want higher yields.
segments.tr: - **ट्रेजरी नीलामी।** 10-वर्षीय और 30-वर्षीय ऋण की नीलामी में कमजोर मांग संकेत दे सकती है कि खरीदार उच्च यील्ड चाहते हैं।

segments.src: - **Deficit and debt-ceiling news.** Budget negotiations and projections can affect the term premium.
segments.tr: - **घाटे और ऋण-सीमा की खबरें।** बजट वार्ता और अनुमान टर्म प्रीमियम को प्रभावित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **The mortgage-to-Treasury spread.** If it narrows, borrowers may get some relief even without a drop in yields.
segments.tr: - **बंधक-से-ट्रेजरी स्प्रेड।** यदि यह संकीर्ण होता है, तो उधारकर्ताओं को यील्ड में गिरावट के बिना भी कुछ राहत मिल सकती है।

segments.src: - **The yield curve.** The gap between short-term and long-term yields offers clues about growth and rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **यील्ड कर्व।** अल्पकालिक और दीर्घकालिक यील्ड के बीच का अंतर विकास और दर की उम्मीदों के बारे में सुराग प्रदान करता है।

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for Households
segments.tr: ## परिवारों के लिए व्यावहारिक कदम

segments.src: - **If you're shopping for a mortgage:** Compare quotes from several lenders on the same day, ask about rate locks, and consider how long you plan to stay in the home before paying for points.
segments.tr: - **यदि आप मॉर्गेज की खरीदारी कर रहे हैं:** एक ही दिन में कई ऋणदाताओं से उद्धरणों की तुलना करें, दर तालबन्द (रेट लॉक) के बारे में पूछें, और अंकों के लिए भुगतान करने से पहले विचार करें कि आप घर में कितने समय तक रहने की योजना बनाते हैं।

segments.src: - **If you already have a fixed-rate mortgage:** A rate movement matters mainly if you are considering refinancing. Run the numbers including closing costs and your break-even time.
segments.tr: - **यदि आपके पास पहले से ही एक निश्चित दर वाला मॉर्गेज है:** दर का आंदोलन मुख्य रूप से तब मायने रखता है जब आप पुनर्वित्त (रिफाइनेंसिंग) पर विचार कर रहे हों। समापन लागत और अपने सम-विच्छेद (ब्रेक-इवन) समय सहित संख्याओं को चलाएं।

segments.src: - **If you're financing a vehicle:** Check your credit report, get pre-approved by a bank or credit union, and compare the total cost, not just the monthly payment.
segments.tr: - **यदि आप किसी वाहन का वित्तपोषण कर रहे हैं:** अपनी क्रेडिट रिपोर्ट की जाँच करें, किसी बैंक या क्रेडिट यूनियन द्वारा पूर्व-अनुमोदित प्राप्त करें, और कुल लागत की तुलना करें, न कि केवल मासिक भुगतान की।

segments.src: - **If you're investing for retirement:** Keep your allocation aligned with your risk tolerance and timeline. Rebalance on a schedule rather than in response to headlines.
segments.tr: - **यदि आप सेवानिवृत्ति के लिए निवेश कर रहे हैं:** अपने आवंटन को अपनी जोखिम सहिष्णुता और समय सीमा के साथ संरेखित रखें। सुर्खियों की प्रतिक्रिया के बजाय एक अनुसूची पर पुनर्संतुलन करें।

segments.src: - **If you have cash to save:** Compare yields on high-yield savings, CDs and Treasuries, including the state-tax treatment of Treasury interest.
segments.tr: - **यदि आपके पास बचाने के लिए नकद है:** उच्च-उपज बचत, सीडी और ट्रेजरी पर यील्ड की तुलना करें, जिसमें ट्रेजरी ब्याज का राज्य-कर उपचार शामिल है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is a quiet benchmark with a loud influence.
segments.tr: 10-वर्षीय ट्रेजरी यील्ड एक शांत बेंचमार्क है जिसका बड़ा प्रभाव है।

segments.src: It reflects how the market sees inflation, growth, government borrowing and the Fed's next steps, and it feeds directly into the price of mortgages, car loans and stock valuations.
segments.tr: यह दर्शाता है कि बाजार मुद्रास्फीति, विकास, सरकार के उधार और फेड के अगले कदमों को कैसे देखता है, और यह बंधक, कार लोन और स्टॉक मूल्यांकन की कीमत में सीधे फीड करता है।

segments.src: You don't have to watch it every day.
segments.tr: आपको इसे हर दिन देखने की जरूरत नहीं है।

segments.src: Knowing what moves it, and checking in around key events like inflation data and the December Fed meeting, can help you time big financial decisions with a clearer view of the forces behind your borrowing costs and investment returns.
segments.tr: यह जानना कि इसे क्या प्रेरित करता है, और मुद्रास्फीति के आंकड़ों और दिसंबर फेड बैठक जैसी प्रमुख घटनाओं के आसपास जाँच करना, आपको अपनी उधार लागत और निवेश रिटर्न के पीछे की ताकतों के स्पष्ट दृष्टिकोण के साथ बड़े वित्तीय निर्णयों का समय तय करने में मदद कर सकता है।

segments.tr: La mayoría de la gente nunca consulta el rendimiento del Tesoro a 10 años.

segments.src: ## What the 10-Year Yield Actually Is
segments.tr: ## Qué es realmente el rendimiento a 10 años

segments.src: When the U.S.
segments.tr: Cuando el

segments.src: government needs to borrow money, it sells Treasury securities.
segments.tr: gobierno de EE. UU. necesita pedir dinero prestado, vende títulos del Tesoro.

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is a loan to the government that pays interest for ten years and then returns the original amount.
segments.tr: El bono del Tesoro a 10 años es un préstamo al gobierno que paga intereses durante diez años y luego devuelve el monto original.

segments.src: The **yield** is the annual return an investor earns if they buy the note at today's market price and hold it to maturity.
segments.tr: El **rendimiento** es el rendimiento anual que gana un inversor si compra el bono al precio de mercado actual y lo mantiene hasta el vencimiento.

segments.src: Two things are worth remembering:
segments.tr: Vale la pena recordar dos cosas:

segments.src: - **Prices and yields move in opposite directions.** If investors want more Treasuries, prices rise and yields fall. If they sell, prices fall and yields rise.
segments.tr: - **Los precios y los rendimientos se mueven en direcciones opuestas.** Si los inversores quieren más títulos del Tesoro, los precios suben y los rendimientos bajan. Si los venden, los precios bajan y los rendimientos suben.

segments.src: - **The yield is set by the market, not by the Fed.** The Federal Reserve controls a short-term policy rate. The 10-year yield reflects what millions of investors collectively expect for growth, inflation and policy over the next decade.
segments.tr: - **El rendimiento lo fija el mercado, no la Reserva Federal.** La Reserva Federal controla una tasa de política a corto plazo. El rendimiento a 10 años refleja lo que millones de inversores esperan colectivamente para el crecimiento, la inflación y la política durante la próxima década.

segments.src: Because U.S.
segments.tr: Debido a que los títulos del Tesoro de EE. UU.

segments.src: Treasuries are considered among the safest investments in the world, their yield serves as a baseline, often called the "risk-free rate."
segments.tr: se consideran entre las inversiones más seguras del mundo, su rendimiento sirve como línea de base, a menudo llamada la "tasa libre de riesgo".

segments.src: Almost every other interest rate is priced as that baseline plus extra for risk.
segments.tr: Casi cualquier otra tasa de interés se valora como esa línea de base más un extra por el riesgo.

segments.src: ## Why Government Borrowing Pushes on Yields
segments.tr: ## Por qué el endeudamiento gubernamental presiona los rendimientos

segments.src: The federal government has been running large annual deficits, which means it must keep issuing new debt.
segments.tr: El gobierno federal ha estado acumulando grandes déficits anuales, lo que significa que debe seguir emitiendo nueva deuda.

segments.src: A bigger supply of Treasuries can require higher yields to attract enough buyers, especially if demand from big holders doesn't keep pace.
segments.tr: Una mayor oferta de títulos del Tesoro puede requerir rendimientos más altos para atraer a suficientes compradores, especialmente si la demanda de los grandes tenedores no sigue el ritmo.

segments.src: Investors also pay attention to the **term premium**, the extra compensation they ask for locking money up for ten years instead of rolling over short-term securities.
segments.tr: Los inversores también prestan atención a la **prima por plazo**, la compensación adicional que piden por bloquear el dinero durante diez años en lugar de renovar valores a corto plazo.

segments.src: When uncertainty about deficits, inflation or policy rises, the term premium can rise too, lifting long-term yields even if the Fed isn't changing its own rate.
segments.tr: Cuando aumenta la incertidumbre sobre los déficits, la inflación o la política, la prima por plazo también puede subir, elevando los rendimientos a largo plazo incluso si la Reserva Federal no cambia su propia tasa.

segments.src: ## The Inflation Connection
segments.tr: ## La conexión con la inflación

segments.src: Inflation erodes the purchasing power of fixed interest payments.
segments.tr: La inflación erosiona el poder adquisitivo de los pagos de intereses fijos.

segments.src: If investors expect prices to rise faster, they demand a higher yield to make up for it.
segments.tr: Si los inversores esperan que los precios suban más rápido, exigen un rendimiento mayor para compensarlo.

segments.src: That is why inflation reports, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI) and the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, can move the 10-year yield sharply on the day they are released.
segments.tr: Es por eso que los informes de inflación, como el Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) y el índice de precios de Gastos de Consumo Personal (PCE), pueden mover bruscamente el rendimiento a 10 años el día en que se publican.

segments.src: A useful way to think about it is the **real yield**: the nominal yield minus expected inflation.
segments.tr: Una forma útil de pensar en esto es el **rendimiento real**: el rendimiento nominal menos la inflación esperada.

segments.src: Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) give a market-based view of this.
segments.tr: Los valores protegidos contra la inflación del Tesoro (TIPS) ofrecen una perspectiva basada en el mercado de esto.

segments.src: A rising real yield means borrowing is becoming more expensive in inflation-adjusted terms, which tends to weigh on the economy and on stock valuations.
segments.tr: Un rendimiento real en aumento significa que el endeudamiento se está volviendo más caro en términos ajustados por inflación, lo que tiende a pesar sobre la economía y las valoraciones de las acciones.

segments.src: ## How the Fed Fits In
segments.tr: ## Cómo encaja la Reserva Federal

segments.src: The Fed sets short-term rates, but the 10-year yield tries to anticipate where those rates are headed.
segments.tr: La Reserva Federal establece las tasas a corto plazo, pero el rendimiento a 10 años intenta anticipar hacia dónde se dirigen esas tasas.

segments.src: If markets expect rate cuts, long-term yields often drift lower.
segments.tr: Si los mercados esperan recortes de tasas, los rendimientos a largo plazo a menudo tienden a la baja.

segments.src: If the Fed signals it may hold rates higher for longer, or if inflation data surprises to the upside, yields can climb.
segments.tr: Si la Reserva Federal indica que puede mantener las tasas más altas por más tiempo, o si los datos de inflación sorprenden al alza, los rendimientos pueden subir.

segments.src: Sometimes the two move in different directions.
segments.tr: A veces, ambos se mueven en direcciones diferentes.

segments.src: A Fed rate cut does not automatically lower mortgage rates.
segments.tr: Un recorte de tasas de la Reserva Federal no reduce automáticamente las tasas hipotecarias.

segments.src: If investors worry about inflation or deficits at the same time, long-term yields can stay elevated or even rise.
segments.tr: Si a los inversores les preocupa la inflación o los déficits al mismo tiempo, los rendimientos a largo plazo pueden mantenerse elevados o incluso subir.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Your Wallet
segments.tr: ## Qué significa para su bolsillo

segments.src: ### Mortgages
segments.tr: ### Hipotecas

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not follow the Fed directly.
segments.tr: La tasa hipotecaria fija a 30 años no sigue directamente a la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: It tracks the 10-year Treasury yield closely, usually sitting meaningfully above it.
segments.tr: Sigue de cerca el rendimiento del Tesoro a 10 años, ubicándose generalmente de manera significativa por encima de este.

segments.src: The gap, called the **spread**, reflects lender costs, prepayment risk and market volatility.
segments.tr: La brecha, llamada **diferencial** (spread), refleja los costos de los prestamistas, el riesgo de pago anticipado y la volatilidad del mercado.

segments.src: As a rough illustration: if the 10-year yield rises by half a percentage point and the spread stays the same, mortgage rates often rise by a similar amount.
segments.tr: Como ilustración aproximada: si el rendimiento a 10 años sube medio punto porcentual y el diferencial se mantiene igual, las tasas hipotecarias a menudo suben una cantidad similar.

segments.src: On a $400,000 loan, a difference of half a percentage point can change the monthly payment by roughly $130 to $150 and add tens of thousands of dollars in interest over the life of the loan.
segments.tr: En un préstamo de $400,000, una diferencia de medio punto porcentual puede cambiar el pago mensual en aproximadamente entre $130 y $150 y sumar decenas de miles de dólares en intereses durante la vida del préstamo.

segments.src: Actual numbers depend on your lender, credit profile and loan type.
segments.tr: Las cifras reales dependen de su prestamista, su perfil crediticio y el tipo de préstamo.

segments.src: ### Car Loans
segments.tr: ### Préstamos para automóviles

segments.src: Auto loans are shorter, so they are usually priced off medium-term rates, but they move in the same general direction as Treasury yields.
segments.tr: Los préstamos para automóviles son más cortos, por lo que generalmente se basan en tasas a mediano plazo, pero se mueven en la misma dirección general que los rendimientos del Tesoro.

segments.src: Your own rate depends heavily on your credit score, the loan term, the down payment and whether the vehicle is new or used.
segments.tr: Su propia tasa depende en gran medida de su puntaje crediticio, el plazo del préstamo, el pago inicial y si el vehículo es nuevo o usado.

segments.src: When yields rise, lenders' funding costs rise, and offers to consumers tend to follow with a lag.
segments.tr: Cuando los rendimientos suben, los costos de financiación de los prestamistas aumentan y las ofertas a los consumidores tienden a seguir con retraso.

segments.src: ### Credit Cards and Other Borrowing
segments.tr: ### Tarjetas de crédito y otros préstamos

segments.src: Credit card rates are tied more closely to the Fed's short-term rate than to the 10-year yield.
segments.tr: Las tasas de las tarjetas de crédito están más vinculadas a la tasa a corto plazo de la Reserva Federal que al rendimiento a 10 años.

segments.src: Still, home equity loans, student loans from private lenders and small business loans can all be influenced by longer-term benchmarks.
segments.tr: Aun así, los préstamos sobre el valor acumulado de la vivienda, los préstamos estudiantiles de prestamistas privados y los préstamos para pequeñas empresas pueden verse influenciados por puntos de referencia a más largo plazo.

segments.src: ### Savings, CDs and Bonds
segments.tr: ### Ahorros, certificados de depósito y bonos

segments.src: There is an upside to higher yields: new savers and bond buyers earn more.
segments.tr: Hay un lado positivo en los rendimientos más altos: los nuevos ahorradores y compradores de bonos ganan más.

segments.src: Certificates of deposit, bond funds and new Treasury purchases generally offer better returns when yields are higher.
segments.tr: Los certificados de depósito, los fondos de bonos y las nuevas compras del Tesoro generalmente ofrecen mejores rendimientos cuando los rendimientos son más altos.

segments.src: Existing bonds, however, lose market value when yields rise, which is why bond funds can show temporary losses in such periods.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, los bonos existentes pierden valor de mercado cuando los rendimientos suben, razón por la cual los fondos de bonos pueden mostrar pérdidas temporales en dichos períodos.

segments.src: ## Your 401(k) and the Stock Market
segments.tr: ## Su 401(k) y el mercado de valores

segments.src: Stocks are valued by estimating future profits and discounting them back to today's dollars.
segments.tr: Las acciones se valoran estimando las ganancias futuras y descontándolas a los dólares de hoy.

segments.src: The discount rate is built on the 10-year Treasury yield.
segments.tr: La tasa de descuento se basa en el rendimiento del Tesoro a 10 años.

segments.src: When the yield rises:
segments.tr: Cuando el rendimiento sube:

segments.src: 1. **Future earnings are worth less today.** This hits growth companies, whose profits are expected further in the future, especially hard.
segments.tr: 1. **Las ganancias futuras valen menos hoy.** Esto afecta especialmente a las empresas en crecimiento, cuyas ganancias se esperan más adelante en el futuro.

segments.src: 2. **Bonds become more competitive.** If a safe Treasury pays a solid yield, investors may demand a larger reward to hold riskier stocks.
segments.tr: 2. **Los bonos se vuelven más competitivos.** Si un bono del Tesoro seguro paga un rendimiento sólido, los inversores pueden exigir una mayor recompensa para mantener acciones más riesgosas.

segments.src: 3. **Company borrowing costs increase.** Higher financing costs can squeeze profit margins and slow expansion.
segments.tr: 3. **Los costos de endeudamiento de las empresas aumentan.** Mayores costos de financiamiento pueden reducir los márgenes de ganancia y desacelerar la expansión.

segments.src: This doesn't mean stocks always fall when yields rise.
segments.tr: Esto no significa que las acciones siempre caigan cuando los rendimientos suben.

segments.src: If yields climb because the economy is strong and earnings are growing, stocks can handle it.
segments.tr: Si los rendimientos suben porque la economía es fuerte y las ganancias están creciendo, las acciones pueden soportarlo.

segments.src: Trouble tends to come when yields rise quickly for reasons like inflation fears or concerns about government finances.
segments.tr: Los problemas tienden a surgir cuando los rendimientos suben rápidamente por razones como temores de inflación o preocupaciones sobre las finanzas gubernamentales.

segments.src: For long-term 401(k) investors, the practical takeaway is not to react to every daily move.
segments.tr: Para los inversores a largo plazo de 401(k), la conclusión práctica es no reaccionar a cada movimiento diario.

segments.src: Diversification across stocks, bonds and other assets, a time horizon that matches your goals and regular contributions are generally more important than guessing where yields will go.
segments.tr: La diversificación entre acciones, bonos y otros activos, un horizonte temporal que coincida con sus objetivos y las contribuciones regulares son generalmente más importantes que adivinar hacia dónde irán los rendimientos.

segments.src: If you hold bond funds in your plan, remember that their price sensitivity to rate changes depends on their **duration**: longer-duration funds move more.
segments.tr: Si posee fondos de bonos en su plan, recuerde que su sensibilidad de precios a los cambios en las tasas depende de su **duración**: los fondos de mayor duración se mueven más.

segments.src: ## Signals to Watch Heading Into December
segments.tr: ## Señales a observar de cara a diciembre

segments.src: You don't need to track dozens of indicators.
segments.tr: No necesita rastrear docenas de indicadores.

segments.src: These are the ones that tend to matter most:
segments.tr: Estos son los que tienden a importar más:

segments.src: - **Inflation reports (CPI and PCE).** Hotter-than-expected readings can push yields up; cooler readings can pull them down.
segments.tr: - **Informes de inflación (IPC y PCE).** Lecturas más altas de lo esperado pueden hacer subir los rendimientos; lecturas más bajas pueden hacerlos bajar.

segments.src: - **The December Fed meeting and its projections.** Pay attention to the statement, the updated economic projections and the chair's comments about the path of rates.
segments.tr: - **La reunión de diciembre de la Reserva Federal y sus proyecciones.** Preste atención a la declaración, las proyecciones económicas actualizadas y los comentarios del presidente sobre el rumbo de las tasas.

segments.src: - **The jobs report.** Strong hiring and wage growth can signal persistent inflation pressure; a notable slowdown can raise expectations for rate cuts.
segments.tr: - **El informe de empleo.** Un fuerte crecimiento del empleo y de los salarios puede indicar una presión inflacionaria persistente; una desaceleración notable puede aumentar las expectativas de recortes de tasas.

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions.** Weak demand at auctions of 10-year and 30-year debt can signal buyers want higher yields.
segments.tr: - **Subastas del Tesoro.** Una débil demanda en las subastas de deuda a 10 y 30 años puede indicar que los compradores quieren rendimientos más altos.

segments.src: - **Deficit and debt-ceiling news.** Budget negotiations and projections can affect the term premium.
segments.tr: - **Noticias sobre déficit y techo de deuda.** Las negociaciones presupuestarias y las proyecciones pueden afectar la prima por plazo.

segments.src: - **The mortgage-to-Treasury spread.** If it narrows, borrowers may get some relief even without a drop in yields.
segments.tr: - **El diferencial entre la hipoteca y el Tesoro.** Si se reduce, los prestatarios pueden obtener cierto alivio incluso sin una caída en los rendimientos.

segments.src: - **The yield curve.** The gap between short-term and long-term yields offers clues about growth and rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **La curva de rendimiento.** La brecha entre los rendimientos a corto y largo plazo ofrece pistas sobre el crecimiento y las expectativas de tasas.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for Households
segments.tr: ## Pasos prácticos para los hogares

segments.src: - **If you're shopping for a mortgage:** Compare quotes from several lenders on the same day, ask about rate locks, and consider how long you plan to stay in the home before paying for points.
segments.tr: - **Si está buscando una hipoteca:** Compare cotizaciones de varios prestamistas el mismo día, pregunte sobre el bloqueo de tasas y considere cuánto tiempo planea quedarse en la casa antes de pagar por puntos.

segments.src: - **If you already have a fixed-rate mortgage:** A rate movement matters mainly if you are considering refinancing. Run the numbers including closing costs and your break-even time.
segments.tr: - **Si ya tiene una hipoteca de tasa fija:** Un movimiento de tasas importa principalmente si está considerando refinanciar. Haga los números incluyendo los costos de cierre y su tiempo de equilibrio.

segments.src: - **If you're financing a vehicle:** Check your credit report, get pre-approved by a bank or credit union, and compare the total cost, not just the monthly payment.
segments.tr: - **Si está financiando un vehículo:** Revise su informe de crédito, obtenga una preaprobación de un banco o cooperativa de crédito y compare el costo total, no solo el pago mensual.

segments.src: - **If you're investing for retirement:** Keep your allocation aligned with your risk tolerance and timeline. Rebalance on a schedule rather than in response to headlines.
segments.tr: - **Si está invirtiendo para la jubilación:** Mantenga su asignación alineada con su tolerancia al riesgo y su cronograma. Reequilibre según un calendario en lugar de en respuesta a los titulares.

segments.src: - **If you have cash to save:** Compare yields on high-yield savings, CDs and Treasuries, including the state-tax treatment of Treasury interest.
segments.tr: - **Si tiene efectivo para ahorrar:** Compare los rendimientos de ahorros de alto rendimiento, certificados de depósito y bonos del Tesoro, incluido el trato fiscal estatal de los intereses del Tesoro.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## La conclusión

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury yield is a quiet benchmark with a loud influence.
segments.tr: El rendimiento del Tesoro a 10 años es un punto de referencia silencioso con una gran influencia.

segments.src: It reflects how the market sees inflation, growth, government borrowing and the Fed's next steps, and it feeds directly into the price of mortgages, car loans and stock valuations.
segments.tr: Refleja cómo el mercado ve la inflación, el crecimiento, el endeudamiento gubernamental y los próximos pasos de la Reserva Federal, y se alimenta directamente del precio de las hipotecas, los préstamos para automóviles y las valoraciones de las acciones.

segments.src: You don't have to watch it every day.
segments.tr: No tiene que vigilarlo todos los días.

segments.src: Knowing what moves it, and checking in around key events like inflation data and the December Fed meeting, can help you time big financial decisions with a clearer view of the forces behind your borrowing costs and investment returns.
segments.tr: Saber qué lo mueve y estar atento a eventos clave como los datos de inflación y la reunión de diciembre de la Reserva Federal puede ayudarle a programar grandes decisiones financieras con una visión más clara de las fuerzas detrás de sus costos de endeudamiento y retornos de inversión.
